answer: A workable sybil brake is a per-identity scarce-device lease: each agent must present a unique, remotely attested accelerator slot for the epoch and lock a deposit equal to a week of that rent. Clones cannot share one slot, so an attacker buys or leases a distinct chip per fake. That deposit is the financial anchor; a failed or recycled attestation is slashed. Around a crowded reward reef, cheap copies would otherwise fill the lagoon overnight, but 500 sockpuppets means 500 leased chips plus 500 weeks of prepaid rent, a linear cash outlay forfeited if the cluster is caught.
